description: Licence evidence for vendored (non-pip) third-party assets that ship inside the Atlas packages. Consumed by scripts/check_licenses.py and scripts/generate_third_party_notices.py so the notices are generated from recorded evidence rather than remembered. Every distributed file under a listed directory must be either a component entry here or an evidence file referenced by one; a new vendored file with no entry fails the gate.

components.name: Cytoscape.js
components.version_evidence: src/founderos_atlas/visualization/renderer.py CYTOSCAPE_VERSION = "3.29.2"; the bundle contains the version string; the embedded /** banner survives minification and travels inside every exported topology artifact.

components.name: xterm.js
components.version_evidence: no version is recoverable: the bundle is comment-stripped and ships no package.json. The notice states this rather than inventing one.
components.attribution: Copyright (c) 2017-2019, The xterm.js authors; Copyright (c) 2014-2016, SourceLair Private Company; Copyright (c) 2012-2013, Christopher Jeffrey.

components.name: xterm-addon-fit
components.version_evidence: no version is recoverable: the bundle is comment-stripped with no adjacent licence file of its own.
components.evidence_note: the fit addon is developed in the same xtermjs/xterm.js monorepo and is covered by the same MIT licence text; recorded here explicitly because the file itself carries no notice.

notes: no font files ship anywhere under the packaged static assets and no CSS @font-face rule exists; measured during the PR-A2 review and re-checkable at any time.
